text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "The SFOE may request appropriate documentation from the applicant.", "gist": "SFOE can ask for necessary documents from the applicant."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "If it can be assumed that the project will not have any significant spatial or environmental impacts, it is not subject to the sectoral plan requirement.", "gist": "Project not subject to sectoral plan if no significant spatial or environmental impacts expected."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "the SFOE determines whether any grounds exist for exemption from the sectoral plan requirement, or whether the sectoral plan procedure should be initiated.", "gist": "SFOE must decide if exemption applies or if sectoral plan procedure is needed."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Article 1b of the Ordinance on the Planning Approval Procedure for Electrical Systems (SR 734.25)", "gist": "Article 1b of a specific ordinance lists exemption grounds"}, {"type": "other", "quote": "Documents\nTransmission lines evaluation scheme", "gist": "Section header and subheading indicating document categories"}]}
